newsitem.title: USA: U.S. OPTiONS FOCUS/Big roll in Baker Hughes.
newsitem.headline: U.S. OPTiONS FOCUS/Big roll in Baker Hughes.

text.p: Investors continued to roll positions out of expiring January options, traders said Thursday, with the most notable being in Baker Hughes Inc options on the Pacific Stock Exchange.
The Baker Hughes January 35 call and April 35 call each traded about 10,500 contracts.
A trader at the Pacific Stock Exchange said the volume was from an investor rolling a position out to April. The roll was done in blocks of 5,250 contracts.
The January 35 call had open interest of 10,529 through Thursday and the April 35 call had open interest of 124.
Goldman Sachs and First Boston raised earnings estimates on Sun.
Among the options, the January 30 call, which still had open interest of more than 30,350 contracts, traded about 13,380. The option added 9/16 to 1-3/16.
Other busy options included the January 30 put, with volume of 4,550 and the February 30 call, with volume of 4,670.
Traders said other rolls took place in options on ADT Ltd 22-1/2 calls. The January 22-1/2 call traded 3,085 and the March 22-1/2 call traded about 3,000.
